summary: 32-bit RGBA font texture sheet analyzer. Locks the texture surface via ThunkWithArgReorder, derives horizontal/vertical cell divisions by scanning the pixel buffer for key-color sentinels, builds a per-cell glyph lookup table at this+0x6D, then rewrites every pixel: key colors become 0xF0F0F0 with the surface modification flag set, non-key pixels get forced alpha 0xFF000000. Stores the default key color at this+0x2C and unlocks the surface via ArgumentReorderWrapper_3230.

operations.description: Lock the texture surface: call ThunkWithArgReorder with the surface pointer stored at this+0x64 and its pixel-data pointer at surface+0x18; the returned buffer is the locked pixel array.
Read the locked surface dimensions used for all cell arithmetic: width at surface+0x1C, height at surface+0x20 and row pitch at surface+0x28.
Recover the three key-color sentinels from the tail of the pixel buffer (the sentinel row written after the glyph grid) and store them at this+0x28, this+0x2C and this+0x30.
Scan the pixel buffer along the row stride looking for the first pixel equal to the key color at this+0x28; the scan distance yields the horizontal cell count, stored at this+0x34.
Derive the horizontal cell pitch as the surface width (surface+0x1C) divided by the horizontal cell count and store it at this+0x3C.
Scan the pixel buffer along the pitch stride (surface+0x28) looking for the next key-color pixel; the scan distance yields the vertical cell count, stored at this+0x38.

Derive the vertical cell pitch as the surface height (surface+0x20) divided by the vertical cell count and store it at this+0x40; compute the total cell count plus 32 overhead entries and store it at this+0x44.

For every cell, resolve the glyph pixel index by walking the column/row strides and matching the key color; write the 8-byte cell metadata record at this+0x6D (u/v stride indices plus glyph index), advancing 8 bytes per cell.

Rewrite every pixel (width x height): if it equals one of the three key colors (this+0x28, this+0x2C, this+0x30) set it to 15790320 (0xF0F0F0) and OR the surface modification flag at surface+0x18 with 0x800; otherwise force the alpha channel by ORing the pixel with 0xFF000000.
Store the default key color 15790320 (0xF0F0F0) into this+0x2C as the canonical transparency color.
Unlock the surface by returning the result of ArgumentReorderWrapper_3230 called with the same surface pointer (this+0x64) and pixel-data pointer arguments.

clean_pseudocode: int w = surface->w, h = surface->h, pitch = surface->pitch;
keyA = lock[tail-1]; keyB = lock[tail-2]; keyC = lock[tail-3];
for each cell: metadata[this->cells + 8*i] = {u, v, glyph_index};
for each pixel: if is_key(pix) pix = 0xF0F0F0, surface->flags |= 0x800; else pix |= 0xFF000000;
unresolved: The exact semantics of the 8-byte cell metadata record fields (glyph index, u/v stride positions) are inferred from the write pattern, not confirmed against a glyph consumer.
Caller TexturePathParsingAndDimensionCalculation (0x00552F20) determines when the 32-bit variant is used; the relationship to the 8-bit/other-format analyzers is not established here.
